item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect low temperatures ranging from nineteen to twenty-three degrees with mostly cloudy or partly cloudy skies and no precipitation. Thanksgiving Day brings mostly cloudy skies and highs between forty-two and forty-four degrees, with a chance of light rain or sleet developing late in the day. Thursday night turns cloudy and wet across the region with lows from thirty-two to thirty-four degrees and widespread rain, including some freezing rain or sleet in spots, with rainfall totals reaching up to one inch in some areas.
